title: Approximate Adjoint Models for Memory and Compute-Efficient Online Learning of Hybrid Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26095v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Differentiable programming enables online calibration of numerical models by minimizing errors accumulated along simulated trajectories. This includes estimating physical parameters and training neural sub-models in hybrid configurations. Gradients are typically computed using adjoint methods, or backpropagation through time (BPTT), whose computational and memory costs grow with the length of the training window. This limits the duration and resolution of hybrid-model training, a major bottleneck for realistic geophysical applications. Approaches like truncated BPTT reduces memory use by discarding sensitivities across truncation boundaries, introducing gradient bias and neglecting long-range dependencies. We propose a class of gradient approximation methods that preserve the adjoint recurrence over the full trajectory while approximating only the pullback operators within it. translated_title: 面向混合模型内存与计算高效在线学习的近似伴随模型
translated_abstract: 可微分编程通过最小化沿模拟轨迹累积的误差，实现数值模型的在线校准，包括估计物理参数以及在混合配置中训练神经子模型。梯度通常通过伴随方法或时间反向传播（BPTT）计算，其计算与内存开销随训练窗口长度增长，这限制了混合模型训练的时长和分辨率，成为现实地球物理应用的主要瓶颈。诸如截断BPTT之类的方法通过丢弃跨越截断边界的敏感性来减少内存占用，但会引入梯度偏差并忽略长程依赖关系。我们提出了一类梯度近似方法，在整个轨迹上保持伴随递推关系，同时仅对其中的回拉算子进行近似。精确的回拉算子通过自动微分计算（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一类近似伴随模型方法，在整个轨迹上保留完整的伴随递推关系而仅近似其中的回拉算子，从而实现混合模型的内存与计算高效在线学习，避免了截断BPTT带来的梯度偏差和对长程依赖的忽略。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a class of approximate adjoint methods that preserve the adjoint recurrence over the full trajectory while approximating only the pullback operators, enabling memory- and compute-efficient online learning of hybrid models without the gradient bias introduced by truncated BPTT.
